text: The icon patch switches lwtheme-based selectors to nested non-native/light media conditions. Its partial backout restores only the two CSS files. Built-in manifest color and experiment removals stay applied. Accepted CSS selects default, dark or light icon variables from root theme state, with an important dark-scheme override for toolbar and spaces. Keep this narrower source outcome separate from approval, later abandonment and later test repairs. No visual or test run proved the result.
title: The theme icon partial backout restores CSS conditions while retaining manifest changes
